guarantee.body: We guarantee delivery of your Google My Business profile within 7 business days with your exact business information. Otherwise, we refund you in full.
guarantee.body_long: We guarantee delivery of your Google My Business profile, fully configured with the exact information of your business, within 7 business days maximum. If that deadline is missed or the information isn't accurate, we refund you in full, no questions asked.

items.q: Is Google My Business really free?
items.a: Yes, the profile is 100% free. You pay for our expertise to create and optimize it properly.

items.q: I already have a Google profile, can you still help?
items.a: Absolutely. We take over your existing profile and make it 100% compliant with Google's criteria.

items.q: How long does the service take?
items.a: Delivered within 7 business days from receipt of your information.

items.q: What do I need to provide?
items.a: Just your basic information via our questionnaire: name, address, phone, hours, photos and services.

items.q: I don't have photos, is that a problem?
items.a: We guide you on what photos to take with your smartphone. Simple well-framed photos are enough to start.

items.q: Will my profile be visible right after delivery?
items.a: Yes, it's visible on Google Maps as soon as it's delivered. Visibility grows further with customer reviews.
